purpose: Repaint the older catholic films reused in wave 1 so each has its own look (owner: "We can't have the same look for every film").
neighbours: new month-one Catholic films: 2 impasto, 5 glass, 10 retablo, 23 mosaic, 29 comic, 30 film35
rules: If Jesus is in the picture, show him only from behind, as a silhouette, as hands, or out of frame; never show his face.
today shots: Keep the people modern, diverse and real-looking.
each shot keeps its story beat and framing (the old still is uploaded as a layout guide); only the look changes

films.suffix: a two- or three-colour risograph poster print: bold flat shapes, slightly misregistered ink, halftone dots, lime, black and hot pink

shots.name: SC1-Cave
shots.beat: Long ago in Italy, a young man named Benedict left the noisy city behind to pray alone in a mountain cave.

shots.name: SC2-The-Monks-Ask
shots.beat: Monks from a nearby monastery begged him to lead them. He warned them his ways were strict. They insisted.

shots.name: SC3-The-Cup
shots.beat: They soon resented his strict rule, so they poisoned his wine. At supper, as the custom was, they handed him the cup to bless.

shots.name: SC4-The-Cup-Breaks
shots.beat: He made the sign of the cross over it, and the cup shattered, as if a stone had struck it.

shots.name: SC5-Back-To-The-Cave
shots.beat: He stood up calmly. “God have mercy on you, brothers,” he said. Then he went back to his cave to pray.

shots.name: SC6-Today-Bus
shots.beat: today scene, today bus: at your next meal today, before the first bite, you could make the sign slowly, like benedict over his cup. or just pause and notice head, heart, shoulders. your choice.

films.suffix: neon night photography, a real photo not a painting: wet surfaces, magenta, lime and electric-blue neon glow, deep black shadows, long-exposure light trails, cinematic grain

shots.name: AR1-The-Road-To-Ars
shots.beat: In 1818, a young French priest who had nearly failed his studies was sent to Ars, a tiny farm village. “There is little love of God there,” he was told.

shots.name: AR2-Empty-Church
shots.beat: At first, the little church was nearly empty. He prayed there for hours before dawn, visited the farmhouses one by one, and ate very little.

shots.name: AR3-The-Line
shots.beat: They came to confess. Rich and poor, the curious and the lost waited in line outside his church, some all through the night.

shots.name: AR4-The-Box
shots.beat: So he sat in a cramped wooden box, often more than twelve hours a day, freezing in winter, sweltering in summer. Year after year, he listened.

shots.name: AR5-A-Small-Penance
shots.beat: He was gentle. He once said his secret was to give people a small penance, and quietly do the rest of the praying for them himself.

shots.name: AR6-Today-Confessional
shots.beat: today scene, today confessional: name one thing you’ve been carrying in one plain sentence, out loud or on a scrap of paper you can tear up after. if you’re catholic and it feels right, you could look up when your parish hears con

films.suffix: a claymation stop-motion set: handmade plasticine figures and props with visible fingerprints, miniature practical set, soft studio light, shallow depth of field

shots.name: RO1-The-Pebbles
shots.beat: Long ago, in the Egyptian desert, lived a monk named Paul. Every day he prayed three hundred prayers, dropping a pebble from his lap for each one.

shots.name: RO2-The-News
shots.beat: Then he heard of a woman in a village who prayed seven hundred times a day. Paul was deeply troubled. Were his prayers not enough?

shots.name: RO3-Macarius
shots.beat: He walked to the wise elder Macarius. Macarius said: I pray only a hundred a day. I work, I welcome visitors, and my heart doesn’t accuse me.

shots.name: RO4-Knotted-Strings
shots.beat: Centuries later, monks prayed all 150 psalms. People who couldn’t read prayed 150 short prayers instead, counting on knotted strings.

shots.name: RO5-The-Beads
shots.beat: That grew into the rosary: five sets of ten beads. On each single bead, the Our Father. On each of the ten, a Hail Mary. Then a Glory Be.

shots.name: RO6-Today-Mirror
shots.beat: today scene, today mirror: if you’d like, try one decade today, one set of ten: ten slow breaths on your fingers, or ten hail marys if you know them, while you picture one scene, like the road to emmaus. watch, learn, or join in.

films.suffix: a woodblock print: carved line texture, two or three flat colours, visible wood grain in the ink, strong black silhouettes, one hot red accent

shots.name: LE1-Into-The-Desert
shots.beat: After his baptism, Jesus walked alone into the desert. For forty days and nights, he ate nothing.

shots.name: LE2-Forty-Nights
shots.beat: Cold nights, empty days, only stars and stone. When it was over, he was hungry. And the tempter came.

shots.name: LE3-The-Stones
shots.beat: “If you are the Son of God, tell these stones to become bread.”

shots.name: LE4-The-Kingdoms
shots.beat: Then he was shown all the kingdoms of the world. All of it could be his, if he would only bow down. He said no. Worship belongs to God alone.

shots.name: LE5-The-Angels
shots.beat: The tempter left him. And angels came and cared for him.

shots.name: LE6-Today-Ashes
shots.beat: today scene, today ashes: pick one small thing you reach for without thinking. today, when you catch yourself reaching, stop. use that pause for a short prayer, or a kind text to someone. your choice.

films.suffix: a hand-painted 1970s cinema billboard like the giant hand-painted Ghanaian and Bollywood movie posters: broad visible brush strokes, heroic poses, hot saturated reds, teal and magenta, dramatic painted sky, no lettering

shots.name: CGU1-Tepeyac-Dawn
shots.beat: Mexico, December 1531. A poor Indigenous man named Juan Diego was walking to Mass before dawn, past a hill called Tepeyac.

shots.name: CGU2-Lady-Appears
shots.beat: On the hill he heard birdsong and saw a young woman, shining like the sun. She spoke to him in his own language and called him her youngest son.

shots.name: CGU3-Bishop-Doubts
shots.beat: She asked for a church on that hill. Juan Diego went to the bishop, who listened politely and didn’t believe him. Bring me a sign, he said.

shots.name: CGU4-Am-I-Not-Here
shots.beat: “Am I not here, I who am your mother?” She sent him to the hilltop. There, in December, roses were blooming.

shots.name: CGU5-Tilma-Opens
shots.beat: He carried the roses in his cloak, his tilma, and opened it before the bishop. The roses fell. On the cloth was her image. The bishop fell to his knees.

shots.name: CGU6-Today-Basilica
shots.beat: today scene, today basilica: today, notice the person nobody’s listening to: at work, at dinner, in a line. ask them one real question and listen to the answer. if you pray, you can pray mary’s line tonight: he has lifted up the l

films.suffix: a real photograph, not a painting or illustration: a grainy 35mm film still shot on location with real people, Kodak Portra 400, hard natural light, deep real shadows, heavy visible film grain and halation, candid documentary photojournalism

shots.name: LV1-Hillside-Crowd
shots.beat: A huge crowd followed Jesus to a grassy hillside by the Sea of Galilee. Thousands of people, far from town, and nothing to eat.

shots.name: LV2-Boys-Basket
shots.beat: His friend Andrew found one boy with five barley loaves and two fish. “But what are these among so many?”

shots.name: LV3-Gives-Thanks
shots.beat: He had everyone sit down on the grass. Then he took the boy’s loaves, gave thanks, and began handing them out.

shots.name: LV4-Bread-Passed
shots.beat: Bread passed from hand to hand across the hillside. Everyone ate as much as they wanted.

shots.name: LV5-Twelve-Baskets
shots.beat: Afterward he said, “Gather up the leftover pieces, so that nothing is lost.” They filled twelve baskets.

shots.name: LV6-Today-Grace-Table
shots.beat: today scene, today grace table: before your next meal, pause for one breath and name who it came from: whoever grew it, whoever cooked it, and, if you pray, the one behind them both. say the old grace, or just notice.

films.suffix: a hand-painted anime cel: clean ink lines, flat cel shading, lush painted backgrounds like a 1990s theatrical anime feature, huge skies

shots.name: FT1-Nazareth-Morning
shots.beat: In Nazareth, a small town in Galilee, lived a young woman named Mary. She was promised in marriage to a man named Joseph.

shots.name: FT2-Gabriel-Enters
shots.beat: One ordinary day, the angel Gabriel came to her and said, “Hail, full of grace, the Lord is with you.”

shots.name: FT3-Do-Not-Fear
shots.beat: She was troubled. Gabriel said, “Do not be afraid, Mary, you have found grace with God. You will have a son, and name him Jesus.”

shots.name: FT4-Her-Question
shots.beat: Mary asked an honest question: “How can this be?” She wasn’t married yet. Gabriel answered, “Nothing is impossible for God.”

shots.name: FT5-Fiat
shots.beat: Then Mary said, “Behold the handmaid of the Lord. Be it done to me according to thy word.” And the angel left her.

shots.name: FT6-Today-Angelus
shots.beat: today scene, today angelus: at noon today, or whenever you notice the time, stop for one breath. you can watch, learn the words, or join in with mary’s: “be it done to me according to thy word.” or just say: let it be.

films.suffix: a layered paper cut-out collage: cut and torn coloured paper, visible paper fibres, soft drop shadows, handmade diorama depth, bright lime, pink, saffron and turquoise paper

shots.name: OF1-He-Prays-Apart
shots.beat: One day Jesus was praying by himself. When he finished, one of his friends said, “Lord, teach us to pray.”

shots.name: OF2-Teach-Us
shots.beat: He gave them a prayer that starts with a family word: “Father.” The version prayed at every Mass begins, “Our Father, who art in heaven.”

shots.name: OF3-Midnight-Knock
shots.beat: Then he told a story. A man knocks on his friend’s door at midnight: “Lend me three loaves. A guest has come, and I have nothing to give him.”

shots.name: OF4-The-Door-Opens
shots.beat: Because he kept knocking, the friend got up and gave him the bread. Then Jesus told his friends: ask, seek, knock.

shots.name: OF5-Bread-Not-Stone
shots.beat: “What father, if his child asks for a fish, hands him a snake? How much more will the Father in heaven give the Holy Spirit to those who ask!”

shots.name: OF6-Today-Mass
shots.beat: today scene, today mass: say just the first two words today, out loud or silently: our father. you can watch, learn, or join in. on “our,” think of one person you’d rather leave out, and let them in.

films.suffix: an ancient wall fresco on plaster: bold red and black panels, strong ochre and teal, crisp figures with dark outlines, fine cracks in the plaster, vivid not faded

shots.name: EZ1-Water-Gate-Square
shots.beat: After years in exile, the people came home to Jerusalem. They gathered in a city square and asked Ezra the scribe to bring out the book of God’s law.

shots.name: EZ2-Ezra-Platform
shots.beat: Ezra climbed a wooden platform, high above the crowd, so everyone could see: men, women, anyone old enough to understand.

shots.name: EZ3-They-Stand
shots.beat: When he opened the book, all the people stood up. He read aloud from early morning until noon, and helpers explained it so everyone understood.

shots.name: EZ4-People-Weep
shots.beat: As they heard the words, the whole crowd began to weep.

shots.name: EZ5-Feast-Shared
shots.beat: The leaders said, “This day is holy. Do not weep. Go, eat and drink, and send food to anyone who has none.” And the city celebrated.

shots.name: EZ6-Today-Gospel-Raised
shots.beat: today scene, today gospel raised: next time you hear a story about jesus, at mass or right here, try the three small crosses first: forehead, lips, heart. you can watch others do it, learn it, or join in.

films.suffix: a single graphic-novel comic panel: bold black inks, halftone shading, dynamic camera angle, strong flat colour, no speech bubbles, no lettering

shots.name: PC1-Locked-Room
shots.beat: On the night of the first Easter, the friends of Jesus hid in a locked room. They had run away when he was arrested. Now they were afraid.

shots.name: PC2-He-Stands-Among
shots.beat: Then Jesus was standing among them, though the doors were locked. His first words were, “Peace be with you.”

shots.name: PC3-Open-Hands
shots.beat: He showed them his hands, and they were overjoyed. Then he said it again, “Peace be with you,” and gave the frightened friends a job.

shots.name: PC4-He-Breathes
shots.beat: Then he breathed on them and said, “Receive the Holy Spirit.” The locked room was not the end of the story.

shots.name: PC5-Gift-At-Altar
shots.beat: He had once taught: if you bring a gift to the altar and remember someone has something against you, leave it there. First make peace, then come back.

shots.name: PC6-Today-Sign-Of-Peace
shots.beat: today scene, today sign of peace: think of one person you’re not at peace with. you don’t have to fix it today. just wish them peace: in a prayer, if you pray, or in a quiet moment if you don’t.

films.suffix: a real frame grabbed from a 1990s music video on worn VHS tape, not a painting: heavy chromatic aberration, thick scan lines, tape noise and tracking glitches, oversaturated magenta and cyan, fisheye low-angle handheld camera

shots.name: SD1-Abitinae-Dawn
shots.beat: Around the year 304, in a North African town called Abitinae, the Roman emperor banned Christians from meeting. Their holy books were being taken away.

shots.name: SD2-House-Mass
shots.beat: But every Sunday, a group of them still gathered in a house, with their priest, to share the Lord’s supper: the Mass.

shots.name: SD3-Soldiers-At-Door
shots.beat: Soldiers found them and took them to the city of Carthage, to stand before the Roman governor.

shots.name: SD4-Before-Governor
shots.beat: The governor asked why they had broken the emperor’s order. A man named Emeritus, who had opened his house to them, answered.

shots.name: SD5-Without-Sunday
shots.beat: “Without Sunday, we cannot live.” Many of them never came home. But their words are still quoted by the Church today.

shots.name: SD6-Today-Sunday-Table
shots.beat: today scene, today sunday table: this sunday, keep one hour that isn’t yours to fill: mass, if you go, or a long meal, a walk, a call to family. phone face down. if you pray, you can offer the hour to God.

films.suffix: a heavy impasto oil painting: thick palette-knife strokes you can feel, deep black-blue shadows, blazing highlights, dramatic chiaroscuro

shots.name: CFL1-Tara-Dark
shots.beat: Ireland, long ago. On a spring night, the High King at Tara ordered every fire in the land put out. No flame could burn before his own.

shots.name: CFL2-Slane-Fire
shots.beat: On the hill of Slane, Patrick, a missionary bishop, lit the Easter fire anyway. Across the dark valley, the king saw it blazing.

shots.name: CFL3-King-Sees
shots.beat: The king’s wise men warned him: if that fire is not put out tonight, it will never be put out.

shots.name: CFL4-Easter-Vigil
shots.beat: Today, the Easter Vigil begins the same way: a new fire outside a dark church, and one tall candle lit from it, the Easter candle.

shots.name: CFL5-Flame-Passed
shots.beat: Candle to candle, the flame spreads through the crowd, until the whole dark church is full of light.

shots.name: CFL6-Today-Votive-Rack
shots.beat: today scene, today votive rack: today, light a candle for one person who could use some light: a church candle, one at home, or just picture one. picture their face as the flame catches. if you pray, you can pray for them.

films.suffix: a loose watercolour and black ink wash on white paper: bleeding pigment, confident black ink linework, lots of white paper, one or two bold colours

shots.name: CST1-Women-Spices
shots.beat: Very early on Sunday morning, after Jesus was buried, a few women walked to his tomb with spices, to care for his body. The apostles were not with them.

shots.name: CST2-Who-Will-Roll
shots.beat: On the way, they worried. A huge stone sealed the tomb. “Who will roll the stone away for us?” They went anyway.

shots.name: CST3-Stone-Moved
shots.beat: When they arrived, the stone was already rolled back. The tomb was empty.

shots.name: CST4-Two-Men-Shining
shots.beat: Two men in dazzling clothes stood beside them. “Why do you look for the living among the dead? He is not here. He has risen.”

shots.name: CST5-Tell-Apostles
shots.beat: The women ran to tell the apostles. The men didn’t believe them at first. It sounded like nonsense.

shots.name: CST6-Today-Easter-Morning
shots.beat: today scene, today easter morning: think of the stone you named. today, take one small step toward it, without a plan, the way the women did: a call, an email, a first page. if you pray, you can bring it to God on the way.

films.suffix: a high-fashion editorial photograph, real models not a painting: sculptural styled wardrobe, dark seamless backdrop, a single hard spotlight, medium-format crispness, magazine-cover drama

shots.name: CFR1-Assisi-Party
shots.beat: Italy, about eight hundred years ago. In Assisi, a town on a hill, a rich cloth merchant’s son named Francis threw the best parties in town.

shots.name: CFR2-Prison-Change
shots.beat: He dreamed of being a knight, rode off to war with the next town, and was captured. He came home from prison sick, and changed.

shots.name: CFR3-Giving-Away
shots.beat: He began giving things away, even cloth from his father’s shop. His furious father dragged him before the bishop, in front of the whole town.

shots.name: CFR4-Before-Bishop
shots.beat: Francis took off his clothes and handed them to his father. “Until now I called you my father. From now on I’ll say: our Father in heaven.”

shots.name: CFR5-Leper-Kiss
shots.beat: The bishop wrapped him in his own cloak. In those same years, Francis met a man with leprosy, someone everyone avoided. He got down and kissed his hand.

shots.name: CFR6-Brothers-Road
shots.beat: Friends joined him, living poor, preaching in the streets, caring for the sick. They became the Franciscans. Near the end, he wrote a song to God for “Brother Sun.”

films.suffix: a Y2K chrome 3D render: liquid-metal surfaces, iridescent highlights, glossy bubble shapes, silver and lime reflections

shots.name: CMT1-Tax-Booth
shots.beat: In the lakeside town of Capernaum sat a tax collector named Matthew, taking money for Rome. People saw men like him as traitors and cheats.

shots.name: CMT2-The-Look
shots.beat: One day Jesus walked past his table, looked straight at him, and said two words: “Follow me.”

shots.name: CMT3-Gets-Up
shots.beat: Matthew got up from his table, left it all behind, and followed him.

shots.name: CMT4-Dinner-Sinners
shots.beat: Soon Matthew’s house was full: tax collectors and sinners at dinner with Jesus. Some religious men grumbled, “Why does he eat with people like them?”

shots.name: CMT5-Bede-Monk
shots.beat: Centuries later, an English monk named Bede wrote about that moment: Jesus looked at Matthew with mercy, and chose him.

shots.name: CMT6-Today-Young-Man
shots.beat: today scene, today young man: today, start with yourself. bring to mind the thing you haven’t forgiven yourself for, and picture someone who loves you looking at it, and at you, without flinching. then pass it on with one small wo

films.suffix: Afrofuturist art direction: luminous metallic textiles, bold West African pattern, cosmic purple and gold light, regal composition, bold saturated colour

shots.name: CIG1-Antioch-Bishop
shots.beat: Early in the 100s, Ignatius, the bishop of Antioch in Syria, was arrested for being a Christian and sent under guard to Rome.

shots.name: CIG2-Road-Soldiers
shots.beat: Ten soldiers marched him across what is now Turkey. He called them his ten leopards: the more kindness they were shown, he wrote, the worse they got.

shots.name: CIG3-Smyrna-Visitors
shots.beat: In the city of Smyrna, church after church sent people to meet him. Still in chains, Ignatius wrote them letters to carry home.

shots.name: CIG4-Writing-Letter
shots.beat: In one letter, he called the Church “catholic.” It’s the oldest writing we have that uses that word for the Church.

shots.name: CIG5-Ship-To-Rome
shots.beat: Then they sailed on toward Rome, where he died for his faith. His letters were copied and passed from church to church.

shots.name: CIG6-Today-Mass-World
shots.beat: today scene, today mass world: tonight, picture the globe turning. somewhere it’s morning and people are walking into mass, the same mass, in another language. every mass prays for the whole church, everywhere. if you pray, you ca

films.suffix: a two- or three-colour risograph poster print: bold flat shapes, slightly misregistered ink, halftone dots, lime, black and hot pink

shots.name: CTR1-Runaway-Children
shots.beat: In the walled Spanish city of Ávila, a girl named Teresa loved stories of saints and knights. At about seven, she and her brother ran away to become martyrs.

shots.name: CTR2-Uncle-Road
shots.beat: An uncle met them just outside the city and brought them home. So they built little hermit huts in the garden instead. The stones kept falling down.

shots.name: CTR3-Convent-Clock
shots.beat: Grown up, Teresa became a Carmelite nun. Yet for years, she admitted, prayer was dry. She would listen for the clock, wishing the hour were over.

shots.name: CTR4-Friend-Prayer
shots.beat: Slowly, something changed. She wrote that prayer is simply friendship: taking time, often, to be alone with the one we know loves us.

shots.name: CTR5-Pots-Pans
shots.beat: She was funny and blunt. To nuns stuck with kitchen work, she wrote that God walks among the pots and pans.

shots.name: CTR6-Cart-River
shots.beat: People love one story: her cart tipped her into a muddy river, and she told God, “If this is how you treat your friends, no wonder you have so few!”

films.suffix: a woodblock print: carved line texture, two or three flat colours, visible wood grain in the ink, strong black silhouettes, one hot red accent

shots.name: CPS1-Shepherd-Boy
shots.beat: Near Bethlehem, a shepherd boy named David spent long days in the hills with his father’s sheep, and a lyre, a small harp, to pass the time.

shots.name: CPS2-Troubled-King
shots.beat: In the palace, King Saul was troubled. A dark spirit hung over him, and he could find no peace. His servants had an idea: music.

shots.name: CPS3-David-Plays
shots.beat: So David came to the palace. Whenever the darkness came over Saul, David took his harp and played, and Saul was refreshed.

shots.name: CPS4-Songs-Of-David
shots.beat: Tradition remembers David as Israel’s great singer. Many of the 150 Psalms carry his name: songs of joy, of anger, of fear, of thanks.

shots.name: CPS5-Shepherd-Psalm
shots.beat: One of the most loved starts with a shepherd, like David once was: “The Lord is my shepherd; there is nothing I shall want.”

shots.name: CPS6-Today-Monks-Chant
shots.beat: today scene, today monks chant: today, name what you actually feel, in one word: glad, tired, angry, lost. there’s a psalm for it. you can read psalm 23 slowly, or just breathe with your word. if you pray, you can hand God that wo

films.suffix: a stained-glass window: saturated jewel-toned glass panes, thick black lead lines, sunlight blasting through and throwing coloured light

shots.name: VS1-Hill-Road
shots.beat: After the angel left, Mary hurried into the hill country to see her cousin Elizabeth. Elizabeth was old, and expecting a baby too.

shots.name: VS2-The-Doorway
shots.beat: Mary came in and greeted her. The moment Elizabeth heard Mary’s hello, the baby inside her leaped.

shots.name: VS3-Elizabeth-Cries-Out
shots.beat: Filled with the Holy Spirit, Elizabeth cried out, “Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb!”

shots.name: VS4-My-Soul
shots.beat: “Why is this granted to me, that the mother of my Lord comes to me?” Mary answered with a song of praise, and stayed about three months.

shots.name: VS5-Today-Rosary
shots.beat: today scene, today rosary: once today, read the hail mary slowly, one breath per line. you can just read it, learn it, or pray it. notice where the hellos end and the asking begins.

films.suffix: neon night photography, a real photo not a painting: wet surfaces, magenta, lime and electric-blue neon glow, deep black shadows, long-exposure light trails, cinematic grain

shots.name: CJD1-Carpenter-Shop
shots.beat: In Nazareth lived Joseph, a carpenter from the family of King David. He was promised in marriage to a young woman named Mary.

shots.name: CJD2-News-Lands
shots.beat: Then the news: Mary was expecting a child, and the child wasn’t his. In all four Gospels, Joseph never says a single word.

shots.name: CJD3-Night-Decision
shots.beat: Joseph was a just man. The law gave him harsher options. He chose the gentlest: to end the engagement quietly, so Mary would not be shamed.

shots.name: CJD4-Angel-Dream
shots.beat: An angel came to him in a dream. “Joseph, son of David, do not be afraid to take Mary as your wife. The child is from the Holy Spirit.”

shots.name: CJD5-Takes-Her-Home
shots.beat: Joseph woke up and did exactly what the angel said. He took Mary into his home. No speech. He just did it.

shots.name: CJD6-Today-Saint-Joseph
shots.beat: today scene, today saint joseph: today, be the quiet one who stays. one unglamorous thing for someone, done without announcing it: a fixed hinge, a dish washed, a ride given. if you pray, you can ask saint joseph to help.

films.suffix: a claymation stop-motion set: handmade plasticine figures and props with visible fingerprints, miniature practical set, soft studio light, shallow depth of field

shots.name: CGR1-Road-Bethlehem
shots.beat: The emperor ordered everyone counted, so Joseph took Mary, very pregnant, on the long road to Bethlehem, the town of King David.

shots.name: CGR2-No-Room
shots.beat: Every guest room was full. When the baby came, Mary wrapped him in cloth and laid him in a manger, a feeding trough for animals.

shots.name: CGR3-Greccio-Cave
shots.beat: Christmas 1223, in the Italian town of Greccio. Francis had a friend set up a manger with hay, an ox and a donkey, in a rocky spot in the woods.

shots.name: CGR4-Torches-Night
shots.beat: People climbed the hill at night with candles and torches. The woods rang with their songs. Mass was said right there, over the manger.

shots.name: CGR5-Francis-Preaches
shots.beat: Francis sang the Gospel and preached about “the baby of Bethlehem” with such tenderness that people never forgot it.

shots.name: CGR6-Today-Creche
shots.beat: today scene, today creche: this week, make a little room: one extra chair at the table, one open hour, one call to someone who’d otherwise be alone. if you pray, you can ask God to show you who needs the room.

films.suffix: a hand-painted anime cel: clean ink lines, flat cel shading, lush painted backgrounds like a 1990s theatrical anime feature, huge skies

shots.name: CSH1-Field-Night
shots.beat: That same night, in the fields outside Bethlehem, shepherds were keeping watch over their flock. The night shift, while the town slept.

shots.name: CSH2-Angel-Appears
shots.beat: Suddenly an angel stood before them, and the glory of the Lord shone all around. They were terrified.

shots.name: CSH3-Good-News
shots.beat: “Do not be afraid. I bring you good news of great joy for all the people. Today a Savior is born. You’ll find a baby lying in a manger.”

shots.name: CSH4-Sky-Full
shots.beat: Then the sky filled with angels, singing: “Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace to people of good will.”

shots.name: CSH5-Shepherds-Kneel
shots.beat: The shepherds hurried into Bethlehem and found Mary and Joseph, and the baby lying in the manger, just as they’d been told.

shots.name: CSH6-Tell-Everyone
shots.beat: They told everyone what they’d heard, and people were amazed. But Mary kept all these things, pondering them in her heart.

films.suffix: a layered paper cut-out collage: cut and torn coloured paper, visible paper fibres, soft drop shadows, handmade diorama depth, bright lime, pink, saffron and turquoise paper

shots.name: CSM1-Temple-Steps
shots.beat: Forty days after the birth, Mary and Joseph carried the baby to the Temple in Jerusalem with two small birds, the offering of families who couldn’t afford a lamb.

shots.name: CSM2-Simeon-Waits
shots.beat: In Jerusalem lived a devout man named Simeon. God had promised he would not die before he saw the Messiah. So he waited, day after day.

shots.name: CSM3-Simeon-Holds
shots.beat: He came into the Temple courts, saw one more young couple in the crowd, and took their baby in his arms. Then he prayed.

shots.name: CSM4-Light-Nations
shots.beat: He called the child “a light for the nations, and the glory of your people Israel.” Then, gently, he told Mary a sword would pierce her own soul.

shots.name: CSM5-Anna-Prays
shots.beat: Then came Anna, a prophetess, a widow in her eighties who never left the Temple, praying night and day. She thanked God and spoke of the child to everyone.

shots.name: CSM6-Today-Candlemas
shots.beat: today scene, today candlemas: today, turn one wait into a watch: in a line, a waiting room, on hold. instead of scrolling, look around, or say one quiet prayer for someone near you. if you pray at night, you can try simeon’s words

films.suffix: a hand-painted 1970s cinema billboard like the giant hand-painted Ghanaian and Bollywood movie posters: broad visible brush strokes, heroic poses, hot saturated reds, teal and magenta, dramatic painted sky, no lettering

shots.name: CMG1-Star-East
shots.beat: Far to the east, magi, wise men who studied the stars, saw a new star rise. They packed their treasures and set out across the desert to follow it.

shots.name: CMG2-Herod-Palace
shots.beat: In Jerusalem they asked, “Where is the newborn king of the Jews? We saw his star, and we’ve come to worship him.” King Herod was troubled.

shots.name: CMG3-Gifts-House
shots.beat: The star stopped over a house in Bethlehem. They saw the child with Mary his mother, knelt, and opened their treasures: gold, frankincense and myrrh.

shots.name: CMG4-Dream-Warning
shots.beat: Warned in a dream not to go back to Herod, they went home by another road.

shots.name: CMG5-Flight-Night
shots.beat: Then Joseph dreamed again: “Get up, take the child and his mother, and flee.” They left that very night, across a border, as refugees.

shots.name: CMG6-Today-Chalk-Door
